items.title: Jensen Huang Is Back. Nvidia’s (NVDA) Bull Case Remains
items.summary: Jensen Huang is back at the helm, and Nvidia’s (NVDA) bull case remains in play. Nvidia shares surged 31.5% on November 23 after news of Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, underscoring how closely investor confidence in the company is tied to its co-founder. While near-term volatility is likely to persist, I remain decisively Bullish over the long term. items.title: Don't have time to shop Black Friday? AI will do it for you
items.summary: AI is everywhere, and now it's even jumping into the holiday shopping season, with Meta's Muse set to take over Black Friday shopping for many consumers. On this episode of Market Hang, Wall Street veteran Turney Duff discusses the latest trend with FAS Wealth Partners Chief Investment Strategist Mike Rode; Founder, ETFs Partner, and Portfolio Manager Michael Monaghan; Tema ETFs Head of Investment Strategy Paisley Nardini; and 22V Research President Dennis DeBusschere.
